docs.summary: Global drag and drop system for Origami. Supports typed payloads, hover feedback, drop acceptance with validation, and an animated drag ghost visual. Start a drag from any element, drop in any element that accepts the payload type. One drag operation at a time. The payload persists for one frame after mouse release so drop targets can detect and consume it.
True while a drag is in progress (mouse held).
The current drag payload, or null.
Current drag position in Paper coordinates.
True on the frame the mouse was released after a drag. Payload still available for drop targets.
Begin a drag operation with the given payload.
End the drag and consume the payload. Returns the payload or null.
Cancel the drag, discarding the payload.
